verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a SaaS with web and mobile apps, so opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics, cookies, or tracking controls. The only privacy-adjacent material is about protecting a home address, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
